TechForum Community Guidelines

1. Self-Promotion & Projects

Self promotion is allowed for creators in the designated Show & Tell category.

Please note: self-promotion is limited to once every 7 days (1/7d) per account.

2. External Link Policy

Affiliate links are strictly forbidden. External links are restricted to original project repositories and live documentation.

3. AI Disclosure

All AI-generated content or automated summaries must explicitly state they are AI-generated in the post header.

4. API & Automation

Bots and automated posting are permitted under API rate limits using standard developer keys.
